inputs.text:
The Punjab and Haryana High Court just granted regular bail to this accused under the national security provisions and Official Secrets Act. They claim mere suspicion of sharing sensitive information with a person in Pakistan isn't enough to justify keeping him locked up. He was allegedly only in telephonic contact with this Karachi-based “Punjabi Kuri.” 

But we all know these courts and institutions don't operate on their own. This smells like coordinated damage control by the hidden elites who use these laws to manufacture threats whenever it suits their agenda. The fact they had to let him go anyway points to the accusations being a manufactured distraction to control the narrative and bury whatever real cross-border connections might expose their manipulations.
